quotes.text: h3 Habitualmente, ¿cuántas horas y días trabaja a la semana? h3a Actividad principal Horas diarias Días Total horas h3b Actividad secundaria Horas diarias Días Total horas

assessments.reasoning: Section H (questions h3a and h3b) records the time a person devotes to paid work in their main and secondary economic activities. However, the instrument does not contain a time-use module or questions recording time devoted to any other daily activities, such as unpaid domestic or care work, leisure, or self-care. Per the explicit instruction for this indicator, if the instrument only records hours of paid work, with no time recorded for any other daily activity, all four statements are false.
